_source: Random events (decided Oct 7: rare surprises, random but balanced over time - e.g. 3 bad and 1 good one season, the reverse the next; some ask you to choose; no repeats too soon; softened by facilities, staff and personalities; AI clubs get the same events). Draft list in random-events-draft.md. Numbers proposed Oct 9 night, accepted by Carlos Oct 10. Events that change player morale wait for the morale system (party, bust-up, time off).

events.name: Flu outbreak
events.text: Flu is going round the squad: [n] players are weak this week.

events.name: Food poisoning
events.text: Something at the team meal: [n] players are feeling rough.

events.name: Minor accident
events.text: [player] had an accident away from football and will be out for [n] weeks.

events.name: Training Grounds flood
events.text: Heavy rain has flooded the Training Grounds.

events.name: Storm damage
events.text: A storm has damaged the Stadium.

events.name: League fine
events.text: The league has fined the club [amount] for an administrative mistake.

events.name: Power cut
events.text: A power cut at the Stadium cost the club [amount].

events.name: Bus breakdown
events.text: The team bus broke down; the players arrived late and tired.

events.name: Anonymous donation
events.text: An anonymous fan has donated [amount] to the club.

events.name: Local investor
events.text: A local businessman has paid to upgrade the [facility].

events.name: Viral goal
events.text: One of our goals has gone viral. The club's name is everywhere.

events.name: Fan fundraiser
events.text: The fans raised money to repair the [facility].

events.name: Youth tournament win
events.text: Our youngsters won a tournament. One of them, [player], has joined the Youth Academy.

events.name: Kit goes viral
events.text: Our kit has gone viral. The Club Store made an extra [amount].

events.name: Sponsor bonus
events.text: Our sponsor paid a bonus of [amount] for the team's good form.

events.name: Cheeky bid
events.text: [club] have made a cheeky bid of [amount] for [player].

events.name: Charity match
events.text: We've been invited to play a charity match.

events.name: Big interview
events.text: A journalist wants a long interview with you.

events.name: Naming rights
events.text: An investor offers [amount] for the Stadium's naming rights. The fans won't like it.

events.name: Natural disaster
events.text: A natural disaster has badly damaged the [facility]. The fans have donated [amount] to help.
